decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed disabled access provision will be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), and C.4.3 (Physical Access to Social and Community Facilities) of the London Borough of Hounslow adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and will provide satisfactory disabled access to the development whilst not harming the appearance and character of the existing local area or the integrity of the Green Belt at this location.  In addition, the external plant, in terms of its siting, materials and design, will be acceptable as proposed, and will not be unduly visually intrusive in its setting or harmful to the integrity of the Green Belt.  Nor will it be harmful to the general amenity of neighbouring occupiers in terms of noise/general disturbance, smells or odours.  The external plant details are in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution) of the London Borough of Hounslow adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003). Approval should, therefore, be given for the discharge of both conditions.
description: Following approval for erection of single storey extensions to provide classroom and community /resource room centre - details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (external plant) and Condition 6 (Access for disabled people) of approved planning permission ref 00576/C/S14 dated 18/04/2005.
